roles.label: Admin
roles.description: Runs the workspace: everything a team lead can do, plus roles and team settings.

roles.label: Team lead
roles.description: Plans the work: creates tasks, manages people and assigns work.

roles.label: Member
roles.description: Does the work: picks up, starts and completes their own tasks.

roles.label: Viewer
roles.description: Read only: sees tasks, people and the dashboard but changes nothing.

permissions.label: Create, edit and delete tasks and groups
Add, edit and remove people and their skills
Assign and unassign anyone, use auto-assign
See scores, timed hours and performance
Change roles and manage the team
Pick up, start and complete own tasks
